testcase.name: every food id the asset names is a row of the static catalog

the loader reads the file this test reads
typos and synonyms are lower-case words, one entry each, and no word is both
every recipe estimate of the static catalog has a note
no object of the asset repeats a key
every weight and volume is positive and plausible
parse rejects a missing, an unknown or a misspelt key

recipe notes say what the catalog rows say, word for word
parse rejects a value of the wrong type or out of its domain
parse rejects malformed JSON
every dish has a base and an accompaniment, and its proportions add up to 1
density rules name known categories and each one can match something
container rows name the classes that exist, and a liquid container has a row
parse rejects another version
protected phrases are lower case with single spaces
no list of the asset repeats an entry or holds a blank one
the words the code compares with an accent-free key are accent-free lower case
densities stay between 0_2 and 1_2 grams per ml
